name: Repo Coherence Graph (RCG) -- knowledge-plane debt cleanout: ACTIVE x RELEVANT fingerprinting, mark-and-sweep GC over a typed reference graph, per-root CatBoost + agent-grader + Andrew cohort ratification, executed under gates
description: Andrew-direct 2026-08-03 (CRO terminal, four design rounds; source document = 'Repository Coherence Graph Proposal.docx'). Step 1a of the five-step macro sequence (1 debt cleanout repo+AWS, 2 ontology refinement, 3 comp-tools dialing, 4 deleveraging + resource/pattern consolidation, 5 standing hygiene). Premise, verbatim: 'Only by cleaning out the repo can we establish a clean base by which to facilitate the ontological development of NFRA_VELOCITY.' NFRA_VELOCITY is SUSPENDED (temporarily, On-Hold with open-work ledger) at this project's P0; RCG dispositions are expressed in VELOCITY's ratified lifecycle_class vocabulary (first mass population, Andrew as producer-asserter at cohort grain). Two axes: ACTIVE ('mechanically referenced or depended upon in some kind of runtime' -- computed by mark-and-sweep reachability from an enumerated root set over typed edges) x RELEVANT ('semantically aligned with the current state of the company' -- judged, backed into from ACTIVE via two-pointer review + ratified-core BM25 proximity). Five feature families (filesystem, reference_mech, reference_lexical, temporal, status_declared) with per-file-class confinement; per-root sub-scans (infra/org/data/docs primary) each with own charter, model, calibration; W1 review-prep -> Andrew session -> W2 post-review cycle; RULINGS channel for exogenous business context (verbatim, append-only, rendered to machine effects); planted controls + prospective eval + autonomy ladder (ARCHIVE-in-SCRATCH only, MIGRATE/CONTESTED never automated); dedicated rcg/ folder under a manifest-enumerated write gate (imperative: immaculately clean). Denominator at commissioning: 25,273 tracked files.
